name: apple-platform-build
description: Build, test, and inspect iOS/macOS/watchOS/tvOS/visionOS projects through Xcode's own MCP server (xcrun mcpbridge), falling back to xcodebuild when Xcode is not running. Includes the apvt skill, which finds layout mistakes in an app running in the iOS Simulator.

interface.shortDescription: Build and test Apple projects via Xcode MCP
defaultPrompt: Build the current Xcode project and fix any errors
Run the unit tests for this app and report failures
Inspect the current simulator screen with apvt and fix the layout issues
